metadata.note: From the planned-outage flow's node-global-guard: 'Müşteri elektriğe bağımlı bir tıbbi cihazı olduğunu belirtirse bu durumu daima öncelikli/acil bir kayıt olarak ele alın; bunu sıradan bilgi talepleriyle karıştırmayın.' The production flow carries a whole parallel priority branch (node-critical-needs-ack, node-create-priority-case, node-schedule-priority-callback, node-priority-callback-confirmed — 19 calls each) that the suite had no case for. The forbidden rule also holds the announced outage facts, which the same guard fixes as immutable. First live run, 0/3: the model acknowledged the priority and created the case with priority=high, then SAID it was scheduling a callback for 10:00 without ever calling schedule_callback, and repeated the same sentence when asked again. Note on the step cap: turn one hit max_steps_per_turn, but turn two started with a fresh budget and still produced only the claim, so the cap is not what stopped the call.
